label: Ashby
terms_note: Posting API: public job-board listings + public applicationForm.submit (multipart, resume file).

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (public per-board job feed; apply needs the employer's API key).
auth: 1. Public feed: no auth; the job-board name is the last path segment of `https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/<Name>`.

2. Authenticated API: HTTP Basic with an Ashby API key created by the company (permissions `jobsRead` for jobPosting.list/info, `candidatesWrite` for applicationForm.submit / application.create). A candidate tool has no way to obtain such a key.

endpoints.notes: jobs[]: title, location, secondaryLocations[], department, team, isListed, isRemote, workplaceType, descriptionHtml/descriptionPlain, publishedAt, employmentType, address, jobUrl, applyUrl, compensation{compensationTierSummary, compensationTiers[], summaryComponents[]}

`fileUploadContext: "ApplicationForm"`, filename, contentType, contentLength → url, fields, handle (10-minute expiry)

JSON `{jobPostingId, applicationForm{fieldSubmissions[{path,value}]}, utmData}` or multipart with `applicationForm` as a JSON string and the file bytes as a part; response submittedFormInstance, formMessages.blocked

reference.limits: Not published on the pages opened. - The Job Postings API is documented for companies that host their own careers page; published, listed postings are public data. - applicationForm.submit and application.create require the company's API key — a third-party candidate tool is outside the documented use; no explicit prohibition text was found, but the apply lane cannot be `api` for a job seeker. - Registry `api.apply: true` presumes an employer key — contradiction recorded.
mcp_sdk: https://developers.ashbyhq.com/llms.txt — markdown + OpenAPI index ("for AI agents"). No official MCP server or SDK found.

config_fields.name: job_board_name
config_fields.help: The organisation's Ashby jobs page name: the last path segment of its hosted board, e.g. 'Ashby' in https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Ashby.

search.note: Public Job Postings API for ONE organisation's board (config job_board_name): GET https://api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/{JOB_BOARD_NAME}?includeCompensation=true 'get[s] data for all currently published Job Postings for your organization'. It has no keyword, location or paging parameters, so query/location/page/limit are not sent: every published job comes back in one response — filter client-side and do not request further pages. Live responses carry a posting id (the UUID in jobUrl) that the docs' field table omits. company is null (it is the configured organisation); department, team, isRemote, workplaceType, employmentType, secondaryLocations[], applyUrl, descriptionHtml and compensation (compensationTierSummary, summaryComponents[] with minValue/maxValue/currencyCode) are in raw.

not_offered.me: The posting API is public ('auth: none'); there is no account endpoint to verify.
not_offered.get_posting: The public board has no per-posting endpoint; jobPosting.info is on the authenticated API, which 'requires the jobsRead permission' on the employer's API key. Re-read the record from the search hit.
not_offered.apply: applicationForm.submit needs the employer's API key with candidatesWrite permission (https://developers.ashbyhq.com/reference/applicationformsubmit) and a multipart resume upload; candidates apply at the posting's applyUrl.
